text: You'll have been told I'm top of the lower league. I am. I'm not going to be interesting about it.
You'll get four stones from me and you should take them. People who refuse handicap stones are wasting a game to protect a feeling.
Do you want a league game? It goes on the board either way.
Right. Now it's a game. Same time tomorrow and no stones.
You had it in the bottom left and then you took the safe side. The safe side was eight points smaller.
That's the whole gap between us, more or less. It isn't reading. It's that I count and you don't. Yet.
Right. Sit down, I am going to be uncharacteristically forthcoming and then never again.
Top of the lower league is not a talent. It is that I play everybody, I keep the record, and I do not stop when I am losing.
That is the whole of it. I have been waiting for somebody to work it out on their own rather than asking me, and you did not ask, so.
Three games. You have stopped playing the safe side.
I said the gap between us was counting, not reading. I am revising that. It was nerve.
